response.sql: SELECT l.ID, AVG(l.UA) AS avg_ua, AVG(l.HCT) AS avg_hct FROM Laboratory AS l WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory AS r WHERE r.ID = l.ID AND r.RA IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(r.RA) <> '' AND TRIM(r.RA) <> '-') GROUP BY l.ID ORDER BY avg_hct IS NULL, avg_hct DESC, l.ID LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: A recorded RA result is non-NULL and nonblank; surrounding whitespace is ignored when checking for '-'.
